other_conditions: Beneficiary must be a permanent resident of Gujarat.
Beneficiary must purchase an empaneled tractor model from an authorized dealer as per the department’s empanelment list.
benefits_summary: Provides 25% financial assistance (up to ₹45,000 for tractors up to 40 PTO HP and up to ₹60,000 for tractors between 40 and 60 PTO HP) for the purchase of empaneled tractors.
